info.title: SmartCindy API
info.description: Implemented v1 native chat backend contract. All responses are no-store. Unknown request fields are rejected. Image editing uses the current user message's private attachment IDs; provider-specific fields are not public.

post.description: At most 16 parts, 4 images and 32 KiB combined UTF-8 text. These limits are business rules; JSON Schema maxLength counts characters. Image output uses current-user text and photos.

get.description: text/event-stream. after defaults to 0; Last-Event-ID may be used instead. If both are present they must agree. IDs increase contiguously; clients persist the last processed ID and deduplicate. Terminal replay ends; replay after terminal is empty. Heartbeat comments occur while waiting. Events: accepted {generation_id,user_message_id}; delta {text}; image {id,url,mime,width,height}; completed {status,result_message_id,usage}; failed {status,error}; cancelled {status,error}.
